conclusions: The artifact terminates by CRASHING with STATUS_HEAP_CORRUPTION, not by exiting cleanly and not by hanging forever. That is a product memory-safety defect in the frozen candidate.
The behaviour is NONDETERMINISTIC: 1 crash in 3 runs on an unchanged artifact and an unchanged harness.

FALSIFIES the run-155 claim that the same function returns 'PASS 20/20' at the 240 s constant in 3 m 37.98 s. The --fresh-user path scores 10 checks, not 20, and returns 27 s, not 3 m 38 s. The 20/20-at-240s figure does not reproduce.
Because the result is nondeterministic, no single run can be used as the post-fix baseline, so any rebuild must be re-gated three times.
